summary: Code edited with no build or test after it now stops the session once, a big change is reviewed before a push, one /setup-audit replaces the five audit skills and can show how your questions and reviews really went, the rules are shorter, hooks that watch your wording now hear Russian too, an update moves a Sonnet install to Opus medium with a one-line undo, the installer checks Git Bash and Node, and the free worker reads a .env file only when you ask for it.
